summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a subscription agreement with Pubco (WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp.) in connection with a proposed SPAC business combination with Columbus Acquisition Corp. (CAC) and SpaceAIQ. SEALSQ subscribes for $10 million in Pubco ordinary shares at the redemption price per CAC share, assumed about $10.66, implying ~938,086 shares. The parties amended the BCA to extend the outside date to October 31, 2026. The filing also incorporates the BCA and joinder agreement. What to watch: completion of the SPAC merger and regulatory approvals, with risk-arb focus on redemption levels and closing conditions.
